required_statement: For each fixed standard k, rational filtered G/Gamma and internal polynomial g:*Z^k->*G on an equal-scale box, factor globally g=epsilon p gamma. Epsilon has bounded constant term and multiindex coefficients O(N^-|a|), hence bounded O(1/N)-Lipschitz control on fixed dilates. P is standard connected rational; the same p is totally equidistributed on all dense Cartesian products and every standard finite-index cover. Gamma-valued is NOT required: gamma lies in a standard discrete overgroup and has a standard period moduloGamma in each coordinate. Choosing standard coset representatives on residue classes gives rationally conjugate P-factors. Derive the all-symmetric-box lower-degree representation used by E11/E13 from those actual factors; do not delete gamma Taylor coefficients.
